scene.ko: 파스타 반죽이 손에 달라붙어 강사에게 도움을 청하고, 반죽을 쉬게 하는 이유와 기계 쓰는 법을 묻는다.

lines.en: Excuse me, could you come take a look when you have a second? My dough keeps sticking to my hands.
lines.ko: 저기요, 잠깐 시간 되실 때 좀 봐 주실 수 있어요? 반죽이 자꾸 손에 달라붙어요.
alt: Sorry, could you check my dough when you're free? It keeps sticking to my hands.
Excuse me, can you help me for a second? The dough is too sticky.

lines.en: Sure. Hmm, it's a little too wet. Did you add all the water at once?
lines.ko: 그럼요. 음, 반죽이 좀 질네요. 물을 한 번에 다 넣으셨어요?

lines.en: I think so. I must have missed the part where you said to add it slowly.
lines.ko: 그런 것 같아요. 천천히 넣으라고 하신 부분을 놓쳤나 봐요.
alt: Yes, I think so. I probably missed the part about adding it little by little.

lines.en: That's an easy fix. Just add a spoonful of flour at a time and keep kneading.
lines.ko: 쉽게 고칠 수 있어요. 밀가루를 한 숟가락씩 넣으면서 계속 치대세요.

lines.en: Like this? How will I know when it's ready?
alt: Is this right? How can I tell when it's done?
Like this? How do I know it's ready?

lines.en: Just like that. When it feels smooth and springs back after you press it, it's ready.
lines.ko: 네, 그렇게요. 매끈하고 눌렀다 뗐을 때 다시 올라오면 다 된 거예요.

lines.en: Oh, I see. And why do we have to let it rest before rolling it out? Does it really make a difference?
lines.ko: 아, 그렇군요. 그런데 밀기 전에 왜 반죽을 쉬게 해야 해요? 정말 차이가 있어요?
alt: I see. Why do we need to rest the dough before rolling it? Does it really matter?

lines.en: Good question. Resting relaxes the dough, so it doesn't shrink back when you roll it thin.
lines.ko: 좋은 질문이에요. 쉬게 두면 반죽이 느슨해져서 얇게 밀어도 다시 줄어들지 않아요.

lines.en: That makes sense. One more thing: the pasta machine feels a bit stiff. Could you show me how to use it?
lines.ko: 이해가 돼요. 하나만 더요, 파스타 기계가 좀 뻑뻑한데 쓰는 법을 보여 주실 수 있어요?
alt: Got it. Also, the pasta machine is hard to turn. Can you show me how it works?

lines.en: Of course. Hold it steady with one hand and turn the handle slowly with the other. There you go! You're a natural.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 한 손으로 단단히 잡고 다른 손으로 손잡이를 천천히 돌리세요. 그렇죠! 타고나셨네요.

expressions.en: Could you come take a look when you have a second?
expressions.ko: 잠깐 시간 되실 때 좀 봐 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: How will I know when it's ready?
Does it really make a difference?
expressions.note: make a difference = 차이가 나다 · 효과가 있다

expressions.en: Could you show me how to ___?
